messages:
maria_support: Hey team, Acme report inbound — embeddings endpoint returning inconsistent dims and elevated latency. Customer says: 'our batch job that used to run at ~300 req/s now 5xxs and we see a sudden jump in billing for embeddings'. they pasted an error: `ValueError: Embedding dimension mismatch: expected 1536, got 1024`

alex_dev: Thanks Maria — any trace id or request ids from their logs? That dim mismatch usually means a model variant changed or the client hit a cached model with different output shape. Could also be that the embedding model switched from 1536->1024 due to fallback.

maria_support: They attached one request id: `req_01H7YX9ZQK8T0J2A1XGJ` and a trace header: `traceparent=00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01`. Also they included their request payload snippet: 
```json
{
  "model": "embed-ada-v2",
  "input": ["...long list..."],
  "batch_size": 128
}
```
They say they never changed model.

alex_dev: Ok. Two parallel possibilities: 
1) Routing fallback: requests were routed to a lower-capacity zone using a compatible-but-different model variant (different dim). We have a fallback mapping that can map high-dim->lower-dim variants for cost reasons; that would produce mismatch if client expects fixed vector length.
2) A model onboarding bug where a newly onboarded model got mis-registered with wrong metadata (embedding_dim).

sam_infra: I pulled the request logs for `req_01H7YX9ZQK8T0J2A1XGJ`. Span breakdown looks like: `queue_wait_ms=1200`, `route_selection_ms=45`, `model_load_ms=0`, `inference_ms=180`, `postproc_ms=10`, `response_write_ms=5`. Total server time ~2440ms. There are lots of queued waits at ~1.2s which explains higher P95.

maria_support: The customer is also seeing a billing spike tied to embeddings units — they said their meter shows double tokens billed compared to previous runs. Could the batching/duplicate retries be causing double-charge?

observability-bot: Dashboard snapshot: https://console.redwood.ai/d/embeddings/route-traces?from=1794000000&to=1794200000&query=req_01H7YX9ZQK8T0J2A1XGJ 
Top metrics: `embedding.request.queue_wait` spike at same time, `embedding.fallback.rate` spiked from 0.2% -> 18% in 10m window.

alex_dev: That `fallback.rate` jump aligns with routing fallback theory. If fallback routes to a different model family with 1024 dim, the client would hit a mismatch. Need to confirm model metadata recorded at time of request. sam — can you grep model registry for embed-ada-v2 entries around that time and any variant rollouts?

sam_infra: Searching... found a canary rollout at 1794128600 that introduced `embed-ada-v2-quant1024` as a cost-optimized variant. The rollout policy has a bug: it allowed variant to answer to requests where customers had pinned `embed-ada-v2` by name. So a pin check failed and fallback served quant1024.

ingrid_product: Oh — that rollout was supposed to be limited to internal tenants. I created the rollout config but didn't set the allowlist properly. :grimacing:

maria_support: Great find. That explains dim mismatch. What about the billing spike and retries though?

alex_dev: Two things could cause billing delta: 1) If the variant uses a different tokenization or internal billing unit, or 2) Duplicate retries from client or our gateway retrying on certain 5xxs. Check gateway logs for retry_count header.

sam_infra: Gateway logs for `req_01H7YX9ZQK8T0J2A1XGJ` show `x-retries: 1` and `status_chain: 503->200`. So the client saw a 200 eventually, but we retried once after a 503. That can double-bill in some charging models — we bill on successful model execution, and our retry performed a second inference on fallback node.

maria_support: Customer insists they only triggered job once. They were charged extra on their monthly invoice. Need to tell billing and offer a temporary credit.

alex_dev: Action items: 
- Disable the canary variant immediately (sam)
- Reproduce locally the client payload with batch_size 128 and header `X-Trace-Id: req_01H7YX9ZQK8T0J2A1XGJ` to verify behavior and confirm dim mismatch
- Add trace-level logs to show model variant selected per request
- Investigate retry policy to avoid double execution when fallback is triggered (deploy-bot to coordinate)

sam_infra: Canary variant disabled at 1794128920. I also rolled back the faulty rollout config. 

maria_support: I created a billing ticket and drafted a customer-facing message offering a credit for the extra embeddings units. Will escalate to billing ops.

observability-bot: To help debugging, you can instrument requests with `X-Debug: true` and include `X-Trace-Id` to force distributed trace retention for 30d. Also check `embeddings-per-request` dashboard panels: `model_variant`, `embedding.dim`, `queue_wait_ms`, `retry_count`.

alex_dev: Repro snippet for support to run against staging (python):
```python
import requests
headers = {
  'Authorization': 'Bearer REDACTED',
  'X-Trace-Id': 'test-1794128765',
  'X-Debug': 'true'
}
payload = {
  'model': 'embed-ada-v2',
  'input': ['test']*16,
  'batch_size': 128
}
r = requests.post('https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings', json=payload, headers=headers)
print(r.status_code, r.json())
```
This should surface if staging has the same misrouting.

sam_infra: I dumped the model registry entry for embed-ada-v2 at the time and found two active variants: `embed-ada-v2` (1536) and `embed-ada-v2-quant1024` (1024) with an accidental targeting rule. I've added an invariant check so pinning by exact model name rejects variant substitution. That change is staged for rollback prevention.

ingrid_product: We'll also add a dashboard alert rule: if `embedding.fallback.rate > 5%` for > 5m, page oncall. That would have caught this.

maria_support: Customer wants: 1) root cause, 2) timeline, 3) credit, 4) steps to prevent recurrence. I'll loop back when we have RC and billing resolution.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: rollout/block-pin-variant-fix -> staging (job 7864). CI: passed. -> prod (job 7865).

sam_infra: Prod fix applied at 1794129400. Verified by sending a batch job with same req id pattern — responses consistently 1536 dim. Retry behavior: modified gateway so retries do not re-run model on fallback; instead we fall back to returning original error to client and mark for manual retry if needed. That prevents double billing.

alex_dev: Follow-ups: 
- Add per-request `model_variant` to billing logs so we can attribute charges to model variants for crediting and investigations.
- Add unit test for pin-check in rollout service.
- Notify customers with details + offer 1x monthly credit proportional to extra embeddings units.

maria_support: I'll keep the thread open until billing ops confirms credit and customer ack. Thanks everyone. :pray:
